## 2024-11-02 - Chrome Extension Popup Accessibility & UX Polish
**Learning:** In browser extension popups, dynamic status messages generated by background script callbacks are often invisible to screen readers without `aria-live="polite"` and `role="status"`. Additionally, focus-visible states are crucial for keyboard users navigating tight popup UIs, as default browser outlines can sometimes be overridden or look poor on dark backgrounds.
**Action:** Always verify that dynamic feedback elements in extension popups have live region attributes and that all interactive elements have strong `:focus-visible` styles with sufficient contrast.
